findings.title: Unclear scope of site establishment
findings.message: The description "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" does not specify which facilities, equipment, safety measures or duration are included, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which requires a clear and exhaustive description.
findings.suggestion: Detail the required facilities (e.g., site office, storage, fencing, safety signage, utilities) and the period of provision.

findings.title: Risk transfer for site usage
findings.message: The phrase "vorhalten" implies that the contractor must keep the site ready without additional compensation, which may be an unfair risk shift under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Introduce a separate compensation clause for the duration of site provision.

findings.title: Missing waste disposal specifications
findings.message: The text lacks mandatory details such as waste classification, transport distance, loading method and disposal fees required by STLB‑Bau standard and VOB/C § 4.2.
findings.suggestion: Specify waste class, required transport distance, loading equipment and disposal cost per tonne.

findings.title: Missing frost protection material data
findings.message: No material type, thickness, thermal conductivity or performance class is given, which are required for a frost protection layer under VOB/C and GEG.
findings.suggestion: State the material (e.g., granular fill, X‑type), required thickness (e.g., 30 cm) and thermal conductivity.

findings.title: Insufficient pipe specifications
findings.message: Only diameter and material are given; missing pressure class, standard (e.g., DIN 8077), length per piece and joint type, which are mandatory for PE‑HD pipe supply.
findings.suggestion: Add pressure class (PN 10), reference standard and length per pipe.

findings.title: Lack of details for shaft construction
findings.message: The description does not state the type of prefabricated concrete elements, reinforcement details, connection method or required tolerances, which are required by VOB/C for shaft works.
findings.suggestion: Specify element type (e.g., precast ring), reinforcement layout, joint sealing and dimensional tolerances.

findings.title: Missing concrete class for cleanliness layer
findings.message: The concrete class (e.g., C20/25) and any additives are not defined, which is required for a cleanliness layer under VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Define concrete class and any required admixtures.

findings.title: Missing masonry standard reference
findings.message: The specification does not reference the applicable standard (e.g., DIN 1053) nor the mortar class, which are required for Kalksandsteinmauerwerk.
findings.suggestion: Add reference to DIN 1053 and specify mortar class (e.g., M 7).

findings.title: Unspecified interior plaster type
findings.message: The interior plaster is not defined regarding material (e.g., gypsum, lime), thickness or finish, which are required by VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: State plaster type, nominal thickness and surface finish.

findings.title: Missing technical data for cement screed
findings.message: No class, compressive strength, drying time or details of the edge insulation strip are provided, which are required for CT‑C25‑F4 screed.
findings.suggestion: Add screed class, required strength (e.g., ≥ 25 MPa), drying schedule and strip dimensions.

findings.title: Insufficient details for pavement laying
findings.message: Missing specifications for block size, joint width, load class and surface treatment, which are mandatory for a concrete pavement according to VOB/C.
findings.suggestion: Specify block dimensions, joint width (e.g., 2 mm), load class (e.g., R 10) and surface finish.

findings.title: Missing asphalt binder and layer thickness
findings.message: The description does not state the asphalt mix type, required thickness and compaction criteria, which are required for an asphalt base layer.
findings.suggestion: Add mix designation (e.g., AC‑16), nominal thickness (e.g., 10 cm) and minimum density (e.g., 96 % of theoretical maximum).

findings.title: Missing specifications for asphalt wearing course
findings.message: No details on asphalt type, thickness, surface texture or compaction level are provided, which are required for the wearing course.
findings.suggestion: Specify mix (e.g., AC‑25), thickness (e.g., 5 cm), surface texture and compaction criteria.

findings.title: Unfair clause in preamble
findings.message: The preamble states that the client can extend services without additional compensation, which may be an unlawful risk shift under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Introduce a clear change‑order procedure with agreed compensation.
